{{TAG:0003:0010:}}¡Oh!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Si estás interesad{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}} en un
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}regalo{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} del Día del Trébol,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} estaré
repartiéndolos durante todo el día.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}¡Así que avísame cuando hayas
hecho un hueco en los bolsillos!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Oh !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}En ce qui concerne ces petits
cadeaux que j'ai préparés pour le
jour du trèfle...
... je vous invite à venir me voir
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}lorsque vous aurez fait un peu de
place dans votre inventaire.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Ah!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} Ti interessano i miei {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}regali
speciali per il Giorno del trifoglio{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}?
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Li distribuirò tutto il giorno.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Devi solo passare da me quando
avrai spazio nelle tue tasche.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Oh!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ich verteile heute übrigens den
ganzen Tag die {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Geschenke zum
Kleeblatttag{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Frag mich einfach danach, sobald du
genug Platz in deinen Taschen hast!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Aa!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Yonca Günü hediyesini{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} merak
ediyorsan,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} istediğin zaman
benden alabilirsin.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ceplerinde yer açınca bana söyle.

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Oh !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}Je ne vous ai pas donné votre
cadeau pour le jour du trèfle ?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Je
suis confuse...{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0003:0026:}}Voilà pour vous !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Accifuffoli!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}Non ti ho ancora dato
un {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}regalo speciale per il Giorno
del trifoglio{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}? {{TAG:0003:0026:}}Tieni,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} ecco qua!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Since today is the {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Fishing Tourney{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
I thought everyone might forget
about {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Shamrock Day{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}But having you come over to talk to
me makes me feel quite relieved!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Como hoy es el Torneo de Pesca,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
pensé que todo el mundo se
olvidaría del Día del Trébol{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Pero me alegra ver que te has
acordado y has venido a verme!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Je craignais que tout le monde
oublie de célébrer le jour du trèfle{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
à cause du tournoi de pêche{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Mais en voyant votre enthousiasme,
mes doutes se sont dissipés !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Visto che oggi c'è anche il{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}} torneo di
pesca{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} temevo che tutti avrebbero
snobbato il Giorno del trifoglio{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}... ma ora che sei venut{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}
a parlarmi, mi sento sollevata!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Ich dachte schon, die Leute hätten
wegen des {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Angelturniers{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} den{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Kleeblatttag {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}ganz vergessen...
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Aber jetzt, wo du hier bist, um mit
mir zu feiern, freue ich mich umso
mehr!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Bugün {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Balık Turnuvası{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} da olduğu
için{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
herkes {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Yonca Gününü{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} unutacak
sandım{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ama sen gelip benimle konuşunca
içim rahatladı!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}I can't believe it! You're actually
wearing your {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}shamrock hat{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}You have no idea how happy that
makes me!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I hope you keep it on all day today!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}¡Pero qué grata sorpresa! ¡Llevas
puesto tu {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}sombrero trébol{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Muchas gracias! ¡No puedes
hacerte una idea de lo feliz
que me has hecho!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Espero que lo lleves puesto
durante todo el día de hoy!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}Bravo !{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} Vous avez mis votre
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}chapeau trèfle {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}Rien ne pouvait me rendre plus
heureuse aujourd'hui.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Surtout, ne l'enlevez pas ! Il vous va
à ravir !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}Accifuffoli! Ti sei mess{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}
il cappello trifoglio!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Non hai idea di quanto
questo mi renda felice!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Spero che lo terrai indosso
tutto il giorno!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}Meine Güte! Du trägst tatsächlich
deinen {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Kleehut{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Du ahnst ja gar nicht, wie sehr ich
mich darüber freue!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ich hoffe, du behältst ihn heute
den ganzen Tag lang auf!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}İnanamıyorum! Gerçekten {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}yonca
şapkanı{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}
takmışsın!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Bunun beni ne kadar
mutlu ettiğini
bilemezsin!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Umarım bütün gün
çıkarmadan gezersin!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Today it doesn't matter what you
wear,{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} as long as it's green.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} At least
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}that's what my mom always says!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Hoy no importa lo que lleves
puesto,{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} siempre y cuando sea
de color verde.
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Al menos, {{TAG:0003:0002:}}eso es lo que siempre
dice mi madre.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Peu importe ce que vous portez
aujourd'hui, tant que c'est vert... {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Ma
mère disait toujours ça !
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Heute ist es egal, was man anhat,
Hauptsache, es ist grün!{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Jedenfalls
hat das meine Mutter immer gesagt!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bugün ne giydiğin önemli değil,{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}
yeter ki
yeşil olsun.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} En azından {{TAG:0003:0002:}}annem
hep öyle der!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}It's just not {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Shamrock Day{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} without
a hat like that!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡El Día del Trébol no sería lo mismo
sin un sombrero como ese!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Un jour du trèfle sans chapeau de
circonstance, c'est comme un jour
des cadeaux{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} sans cadeaux !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Senza un cappello così, il Giorno
del trifoglio non è la stessa cosa!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Der {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Kleeblatttag {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}fängt erst richtig
an, wenn man so einen Hut aufhat!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Yonca Gününde{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} böyle bir şapka
olmadan olmaz!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Oh! You're wearing the hat!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}Are you
really getting into {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Shamrock Day{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Accifuffoli! Stai portando
il cappello!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}Vedo che il Giorno del
trifoglio ti ha davvero coinvolt{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Oh! Du hast deinen Hut auf!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}Du
weißt anscheinend, worauf es
beim {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Kleeblatttag {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}ankommt!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Thank you for doing your part to
liven up the day,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} Mayor!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Sono felice che tu abbia deciso di
aiutarci a rendere questa giornata
ancora più piacevole,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} sindaco!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bugünü canlandırmak için elinden
geleni yaptığın için teşekkürler,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} Başkan!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Since you've got the green part
down,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} go out and enjoy the day!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Aujourd'hui, il n'y a qu'une seule
règle à respecter :{{TAG:0007:0000:19000000}} porter du vert !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Adesso che hai indosso la tua
quota di verde,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} vai e divertiti!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Jetzt, da du etwas Grünes trägst,
kann der Spaß so richtig beginnen!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}I'm sure everyone in town will be
delighted to see you dressed up like
this!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0009:}}At the very least,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}I sure am!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Seguro que a todos los habitantes
del pueblo les encanta verte así
vestid{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}!{{TAG:0003:0000:}} ¡Por lo menos {{TAG:0003:0001:}}a mí sí!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Je suis sûre que vous ferez le
bonheur de tout le monde en étant
habillé{{TAG:000E:0006:000002006500}} comme ça !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Sono certa che tutti i cittadini
saranno felicissimi di vederti
vestit{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}} così!{{TAG:0003:0000:}} Beh...{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} io lo sono!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Ich bin sicher, dass sich alle freuen,
dich mit diesem Hut zu sehen!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ich freue mich jedenfalls sehr!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Kasabadaki herkes seni böyle
görünce çok sevinecek!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0009:}}En azından,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}ben
kesinlikle sevindim!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I hope you really enjoy the day
today, Mayor!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Deseo de todo corazón que
disfrutes mucho de este día
tan especial, {{TAG:000E:0006:0E0061006C00630061006C0064006500120061006C00630061006C006400650073006100}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}J'espère que vous passerez une
journée inoubliable, {{TAG:000E:0006:10004D006F006E00730069006500750072000C004D006100640061006D006500}} le
maire.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ti auguro una giornata fuffissima,
sindaco!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bugün gerçekten güzel vakit
geçirmeni umuyorum Başkan!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}I feel like today turned out pretty
great, if I do say so myself.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Aunque igual está mal que yo lo
diga, el éxito de esta celebración
se debe a nuestra organización.
{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Formamos un gran equipo, ¿verdad?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Si voulez mon humble avis, cette
journée est un vrai succès !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Oserei dire che questo Giorno
del trifoglio sembra proprio
il migliore degli ultimi anni.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Ich glaube, heute kann man ohne
Übertreibung von einem gelungenen
Tag sprechen!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Bence bugün gayet güzel geçti,
kendim söylemiş olmayayım ama.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Let's make this a {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Shamrock Day{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}
to remember for years to come!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Hagamos que este Día del Trébol
sea inolvidable! ¡Se hablará de él
durante décadas!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ensemble, faisons de ce jour du
trèfle un moment inoubliable !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Il {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Giorno del trifoglio{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}} {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}di quest'anno
deve restare nella storia della città!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bu {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Yonca Gününü{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} yıllarca
hatırlayacağımız bir güne çevirelim!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Why not raise a glass of
{{TAG:0005:000E:0000}} in celebration
of {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Shamrock Day{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}?
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Brindemos con un vaso de
{{TAG:0005:000E:0000}} para celebrar
el Día del Trébol!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Que diriez-vous de déguster
{{TAG:000E:0002:}}{{TAG:0005:000E:0000}} en l'honneur
du jour du trèfle ?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Evviva! Beviamo {{TAG:0005:000E:0000}}
e brindiamo al Giorno del trifoglio!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Warum stoßen wir nicht mit einem
Glas {{TAG:0005:000E:0000}} auf den
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Kleeblatttag {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}an?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}{{TAG:0005:000E:0000}} ile kadeh kaldırıp {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Yonca Gününü{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}
kutlamaya ne dersin?

DE:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Warum Grün die Farbe dieses
Feiertages ist?{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0020:}} Wahrscheinlich,
weil es schon immer so war!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Bu etkinliğin renginin neden
yeşil olduğunu sorma lütfen.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0020:}}Uzun
zamandır böyle,
gelenek işte!
